sourceGuide.title: The Ayahs of the Qur’an – Muhkam and Mutashabih
sourceGuide.method: Project-owner Muhkam/Mutashabih guide applied under the SalahOS Ashari-Maturidi tanzih policy

editorialPrinciples: Muhkam verses govern the interpretation of mutashabih wording.
No English wording may attribute bodily, spatial, directional, created, sensuous, deficient or otherwise unbefitting characteristics to Allah.
Salaf-style tafwid with tanzih and context-specific Khalaf-style tawil are both supported where the supplied guide and Arabic context permit them.
A verse-specific tawil must not be turned into a universal lexical substitution rule.
The maintained corpus-wide translation-risk registry must give every triggered verse an explicit SalahOS 2026 wording and review-register row; baseline wording is not silently trusted for a trigger.
Qualified scholarly review is required before any whole-corpus religious approval claim.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah requites their mockery, leaving them to wander blindly in their defiance.
entries.editorialNote: The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the divine action is a just requital, countermeasure or frustration of the wrongdoers’ act, not the created defect denoted when the same verb is used of people.

entries.englishMeaning: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein are darkness, thunder and lightning. They thrust their fingers into their ears at the thunderclaps, fearing death; yet Allah's knowledge and power encompass the disbelievers.
entries.editorialNote: The Arabic muhīt is rendered through Allah's knowledge and power, not as bodily or spatial surrounding.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: divine encompassing is understood through perfect knowledge and power, not physical enclosure, extension or location.

entries.englishMeaning: He is the One Who created for you all that is on earth; then He directed His will to the heaven and fashioned it into seven heavens. He knows all things.
entries.editorialNote: Istiwa ila here is rendered without movement, place or direction; the wording expresses the divine ordering of the heavens.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa with a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Where context permits, istiwa is explained non-spatially through dominion/subjugation or directing creation; it is never physical establishment or movement.

entries.englishMeaning: To Allah belong the east and the west; wherever you turn, there is the qiblah appointed by Allah. Surely Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide reports Mujahid's explanation of wajh in this verse as qiblah, in the context of voluntary prayer while travelling. SalahOS does not render the expression as a bodily face of Allah.
entries.salafReading: The verse is understood without attributing a face, direction or location to Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Mujahid is cited in the supplied guide as explaining wajh here as qiblah, the direction of prayer in its context.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Qiblah, the direction of prayers during voluntary prayer while travelling.

entries.englishMeaning: And when We made the House, the Ka'bah, a house greatly honoured by Allah, a place of return for people and a place of safety: take the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer. We commanded Ibrahim and Ismail: Purify My House for those who perform tawaf, remain there in worship, bow and prostrate.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide explicitly rejects reading 'My House' as Allah's residence. It gives the meaning that the Ka'bah is a house of great honour to Allah.
entries.salafReading: The possessive attribution is understood as one of honour and not residence, containment or place for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: The guide gives the specific meaning: the Ka'bah is a house of great honour to Allah.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: The Ka'bah is a house of a great honor to Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: O believers, seek help through patience and prayer. Surely Allah supports the steadfast.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah is rendered as support, not physical accompaniment.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: When My servants ask you about Me, I am near to them by My knowledge and response: I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me so that they may be rightly guided.
entries.editorialNote: Divine nearness is rendered non-spatially through knowledge and response.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine nearness with a meaning befitting Allah while denying distance, physical proximity, contact or location.
entries.khalafReading: Nearness is read contextually through knowledge, response, power, care or the nearness of appointed angels, not spatial distance.

entries.englishMeaning: The sacred month is for the sacred month, and violations are subject to just retaliation. Whoever attacks you, respond in proportion to the attack against you. Be mindful of Allah and know that Allah supports those who are mindful of Him.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah is rendered as support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: Are they waiting for anything except that Allah's judgment should come to them in canopies of cloud, with the angels, and the matter be decided? To Allah all matters return.
entries.editorialNote: The guide rejects movement of Allah from place to place; the coming is rendered as the coming of divine judgment.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revelation while denying movement, transition, arrival from one place to another, place and direction for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Coming or intervening language is read contextually as the coming of Allah's command, judgment, decree, power or effect, not bodily movement.

entries.englishMeaning: When Talut set out with the army, he said: Allah will test you with a river. Whoever drinks from it is not of me, while whoever does not taste it is of me, except one who takes a handful. Yet they drank from it except a few. When he and the believers with him crossed it, they said: We have no strength today against Jalut and his forces. Those certain of meeting Allah said: How many a small group has overcome a large group by Allah's permission. Allah supports the steadfast.
entries.editorialNote: The concluding ma'iyyah is rendered as support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not weary Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
entries.editorialNote: Kursi is retained as the Qur'anic term rather than translated as a throne or seat that could suggest a place occupied by Allah. The wording is governed by tanzih and does not assign bodily seating, containment or location.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed Kursi wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying that Allah sits, is contained, occupies a seat or place, or has any bodily modality.
entries.khalafReading: No verse-specific lexical gloss is imposed here from the supplied guide; the English keeps Kursi while explicitly excluding a corporeal or spatial reading.

entries.englishMeaning: Their guidance is not your responsibility; Allah guides whom He wills. Whatever good you spend is for your own benefit, when you spend only seeking Allah's acceptance. Whatever good you spend will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
entries.editorialNote: Wajh Allah in the devotional idiom is rendered without a bodily face.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: He is the One Who sent down to you the Book. In it are clear verses, which are the foundation of the Book, and others that are mutashabih. As for those whose hearts incline to deviation, they follow what is mutashabih, seeking discord and seeking unbefitting interpretations. No one knows their true meanings except Allah and those firmly rooted in knowledge. They say: We believe in it; all of it is from our Lord. Only people of understanding take heed.
entries.editorialNote: This is the governing Muhkam/Mutashabih methodology verse in the supplied guide. The SalahOS policy reads all ambiguous divine-attribute wording through the clear tanzih foundations and does not permit a created or bodily meaning for Allah.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: The Qur’an contains muhkam verses that are the foundation of the Book and mutashabih verses whose acceptable meanings must agree with Arabic, the Religion and the muhkam foundations.

entries.englishMeaning: Say: O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and take sovereignty from whom You will; You honor whom You will and humble whom You will. All good is in Your power and disposal. Surely You are able to do all things.
entries.editorialNote: Bi-yadika is rendered as power and disposal, not a bodily hand.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed expression with a meaning befitting Allah while denying limbs, hands, parts, bodily form or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Yad and related expressions are read contextually as power, authority, generosity, care or disposal according to the verse, not as bodily hands.

entries.englishMeaning: They schemed, and Allah countered their scheme; Allah is the best in bringing schemes to nothing.
entries.editorialNote: The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.

entries.englishMeaning: When Allah said: O Jesus, I will take you and raise you to a place of honour by My command, purify you from those who disbelieve, and place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to My judgment you will all return, and I will judge between you concerning that over which you differed.
entries.editorialNote: The baseline phrase 'ascend unto Me' can suggest a spatial destination. The English preserves Allah's raising of Jesus while removing any implication that Allah occupies a place or direction.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed raising according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying that Allah is a spatial destination, occupies a place or direction, or is reached by created movement.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: Jesus is raised by Allah's power and command to an honoured station; the wording does not mean movement toward a location occupied by Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: Say: The true guidance is Allah's guidance. Say: All bounty is under Allah's disposal; He grants it to whom He wills. Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
entries.editorialNote: The phrase placing bounty 'in Allah's hand' is rendered as divine disposal and generosity.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed expression with a meaning befitting Allah while denying limbs, hands, parts, bodily form or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Yad and related expressions are read contextually as power, authority, generosity, care or disposal according to the verse, not as bodily hands.

entries.englishMeaning: When Allah took the covenant of the prophets, He said: Whatever Scripture and wisdom I give you, then a messenger comes confirming what is with you, you must believe in him and support him. He said: Do you affirm and accept My covenant in this? They said: We affirm. He said: Then bear witness, and I bear witness to it as well.
entries.editorialNote: The divine 'with you among the witnesses' is rendered without spatial co-presence.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: If good touches you, it grieves them; and if hardship strikes you, they rejoice. But if you remain patient and mindful of Allah, their schemes will not harm you. Surely Allah's knowledge encompasses all that they do.
entries.editorialNote: Muhīt is rendered as encompassing knowledge, avoiding a physical-surrounding reading.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: divine encompassing here is Allah's complete knowledge of their deeds, not spatial surrounding.

entries.englishMeaning: They hide from people but cannot hide from Allah. He knows them when they hold secret counsel by night about words that displease Him. Allah's knowledge encompasses all that they do.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah here is rendered as knowledge, consistent with the verse's opening and closing.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. Allah's knowledge and power encompass all things.
entries.editorialNote: Encompassing is rendered through knowledge and power, not physical surrounding.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the wording while denying bodily surrounding, enclosure, spatial extension or location.
entries.khalafReading: Allah's encompassing is understood through His knowledge and power, not physical enclosure.

entries.englishMeaning: The hypocrites seek to deceive Allah, but He requites their deception. When they stand for worship they do so lazily, only to be seen by people, and they remember Allah but little.
entries.editorialNote: The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the divine action is a just requital, countermeasure or frustration of the wrongdoers’ act, not the created defect denoted when the same verb is used of people.

entries.englishMeaning: Rather, Allah raised him up as He willed, without implying that Allah occupies a place or direction. Allah is Almighty, All-Wise.
entries.editorialNote: The phrase 'raised him to Him' must not be translated as movement toward a location occupied by Allah. The English preserves the raising while explicitly excluding place and direction.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: the raising is by Allah's power and command and does not make Allah a spatial destination or occupant of a direction.

entries.englishMeaning: O People of the Scripture! Do not exaggerate in your religion nor utter aught concerning Allah save the truth. The Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, was only a messenger of Allah, and His word which He conveyed unto Mary, and a created spirit from Him, brought into being by His command. So believe in Allah and His messengers, and say not "Three" - Cease! (it is) better for you! - Allah is only One Allah. Far is it removed from His Transcendent Majesty that He should have a son. His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And Allah is sufficient as Defender.
entries.editorialNote: Possessive/from-Him spirit language is rendered as a created spirit, an attribution of honour, command or divine support; it never means a part, soul or component of Allah.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the spirit is created and may be attributed to Allah by honour, command, creation or support; Allah is not composed of parts and has no soul.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah made a covenant of old with the Children of Israel and We raised among them twelve chieftains, and Allah said: Lo! I support you. If ye establish worship and pay the poor-due, and believe in My messengers and support them, and lend unto Allah a kindly loan, surely I shall remit your sins, and surely I shall bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Whoso among you disbelieveth after this will go astray from a plain road.
entries.editorialNote: Divine ma'iyyah is rendered by support, protection, guidance or encompassing knowledge according to context, never physical accompaniment or co-location.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: ma'iyyah denotes Allah’s support, protection, guidance or knowledge as the context requires, not spatial nearness or physical presence.

entries.englishMeaning: The Jews said: Allah's generosity is constrained. Their own hands are constrained, and they are condemned for what they said. Rather, His bounty is abundant and unrestricted; He gives as He wills. What has been revealed to you from your Lord will increase many of them in rebellion and disbelief. We cast enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they kindle a fire for war, Allah extinguishes it. They strive to spread corruption in the land, and Allah does not love corrupters.
entries.editorialNote: Yad and yadahu are rendered through generosity and giving in the immediate context, not bodily hands.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed expression with a meaning befitting Allah while denying limbs, hands, parts, bodily form or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Yad and related expressions are read contextually as power, authority, generosity, care or disposal according to the verse, not as bodily hands.

entries.englishMeaning: He alone is Allah, worshipped in the heavens and on the earth. He knows your secret and your utterance, and He knows what you earn.
entries.editorialNote: Spatial/fawq wording is rendered through worship, authority, dominion or subjugation so the English does not place Allah inside creation or in a physical direction.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the verse is read through Allah’s authority, dominion, subjugation or being the One worshipped, not bodily location, containment, height or direction.

entries.englishMeaning: He subjugates all His servants under His power. He is the Wise, the Knower.
entries.editorialNote: Spatial/fawq wording is rendered through worship, authority, dominion or subjugation so the English does not place Allah inside creation or in a physical direction.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the verse is read through Allah’s authority, dominion, subjugation or being the One worshipped, not bodily location, containment, height or direction.

entries.englishMeaning: Do not drive away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His acceptance. You are not accountable for them, nor are they accountable for you, such that you should drive them away and become one of the wrongdoers.
entries.editorialNote: Wajhahu is rendered non-corporeally as seeking divine acceptance.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: He is the One to Whom all His servants are subjugated. He sends guardians over you until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take the soul without neglecting their duty.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide explains fawqiyyah here as aboveness of subjugation: all are subjugated to Allah, not that Allah occupies a physical direction above creation.
entries.salafReading: Affirm Allah's supremacy without assigning place, physical height or direction.
entries.khalafReading: The guide gives the specific meaning of fawqiyyah as subjugation: all are subjugated to Allah.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: All are subjugated to Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: Vision does not encompass Him, while He encompasses all vision. He is the Most Subtle, All-Aware.
entries.editorialNote: The Ashari-Maturidi project guide explicitly pairs 6:103 with 75:22–23. Here idrak is rendered as encompassing/comprehending, not as a denial that the believers will see Allah in the Hereafter. The promised ru'yah is affirmed without direction, distance, bodily encounter, or modality.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the verse as revealed: created sight does not encompass Allah. Do not make 6:103 a denial of the promised ru'yah, and do not assign direction, distance, bodily encounter, or modality to that seeing.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual clarification: idrak is rendered as encompassing or comprehending. The verse therefore negates encompassing Allah, not the believers' seeing of Allah in the Hereafter.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Vision does not encompass Allah; this does not negate the believers' seeing of Allah in the Hereafter without direction or modality.

entries.englishMeaning: Do they wait for anything but the angels to come, or for the decisive command of your Lord to come, or for some of your Lord's signs to come? On the day some of your Lord's signs come, faith will not benefit a soul that did not believe before or earn good through its faith. Say: Wait; we too are waiting.
entries.editorialNote: The phrase 'your Lord should come' is rendered through the coming of His decisive command, avoiding movement and place.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revelation while denying movement, transition, arrival from one place to another, place and direction for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Coming or intervening language is read contextually as the coming of Allah's command, judgment, decree, power or effect, not bodily movement.

entries.englishMeaning: They took their religion as amusement and play and were deceived by worldly life. Today We abandon them to the consequence of their deeds, just as they neglected the meeting of this Day and denied Our signs.
entries.editorialNote: Nisyan is rendered as abandonment in recompense, not literal forgetfulness, which the Qur'an negates of Allah at 19:64.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed recompense wording while denying forgetfulness, ignorance or deficiency for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Nisyan attributed in recompense is read as abandoning them to punishment or withholding mercy after they neglected His commands, not literal forgetfulness.

entries.englishMeaning: Indeed your Lord is Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then He exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne, without sitting, place, direction, movement, or bodily modality. He covers the night with the day, each pursuing the other swiftly, and the sun, moon and stars are subjected by His command. Surely creation and command belong to Him. Blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
entries.editorialNote: This is one of the Qur'anic istiwa-over-the-Throne passages. Following the supplied guide's treatment of 20:5, the English uses the contextual ta'wil of absolute dominion/subjugation and explicitly rejects sitting, place, direction, movement and bodily modality.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form and every created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: istiwa over the Throne is rendered as Allah's absolute dominion and subjugation, never sitting, spatial establishment or movement. Allah's attribute of subjugation is not temporally originated.

entries.englishMeaning: Do they feel secure from Allah's requital and taking them unawares? None feels secure from Allah's requital except a people who are ruined.
entries.editorialNote: Makr attributed to Allah is rendered as just requital and taking wrongdoers unawares, not deceit or a created moral defect.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying deception, deficiency, injustice or any created moral defect.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: divine makr is Allah's just counteraction, requital and taking wrongdoers unawares in response to their plotting.

entries.englishMeaning: I grant them respite; surely My measured requital is firm.
entries.editorialNote: The divine kayd is rendered as measured requital rather than a human-style scheme or deceptive stratagem.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying deception, deficiency, injustice or any created moral defect.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: divine kayd is the firm, measured requital and counteraction by which wrongdoers are taken to account.

entries.englishMeaning: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I support you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.

entries.englishMeaning: If you do not help him, Allah already helped him when the disbelievers drove him out, the second of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion: Do not grieve; Allah's support is with us. Then Allah sent His tranquility upon him, strengthened him with forces you could not see, and made the word of the disbelievers lowest, while Allah's word is supreme. Allah is Mighty, Wise.
entries.editorialNote: The cave statement is rendered as divine support, not co-location.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: The hypocritical men and women are alike: they command what is wrong, forbid what is right and withhold their spending. They neglected Allah, so He abandoned them to their consequences. Surely the hypocrites are the defiantly disobedient.
entries.editorialNote: Nisyan attributed to Allah is rendered as abandonment in recompense, not forgetfulness.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed recompense wording while denying forgetfulness, ignorance or deficiency for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Nisyan attributed in recompense is read as abandoning them to punishment or withholding mercy after they neglected His commands, not literal forgetfulness.

entries.englishMeaning: Those who ridicule the believers who give charity willingly, and those who find nothing to give except their effort—Allah requites their derision. Theirs will be a painful punishment.
entries.editorialNote: The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the divine action is a just requital, countermeasure or frustration of the wrongdoers’ act, not the created defect denoted when the same verb is used of people.

entries.englishMeaning: O believers, fight those disbelievers nearest to you and let them find firmness in you; know that Allah supports those who are mindful of Him.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah is rendered as support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: Indeed your Lord is Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then He exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne, without sitting, place, direction, movement, or bodily modality, directing all affairs. No intercessor may act except with His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Will you not take heed?
entries.editorialNote: This is one of the Qur'anic istiwa-over-the-Throne passages. Following the supplied guide's treatment of 20:5, the English uses the contextual ta'wil of absolute dominion/subjugation and explicitly rejects sitting, place, direction, movement and bodily modality.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form and every created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: istiwa over the Throne is rendered as Allah's absolute dominion and subjugation, never sitting, spatial establishment or movement. Allah's attribute of subjugation is not temporally originated.

entries.englishMeaning: When We let people taste mercy after hardship has touched them, they immediately plot against Our signs. Say: Allah is swifter in countering their plots. Our messengers record what you plot.
entries.editorialNote: The English renders divine makr as countering and frustrating wrongful plots rather than human-style deception.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying deception, deficiency, injustice or any created moral defect.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: Allah counters and frustrates the wrongdoers' plotting and requites them justly; no created defect is attributed to Him.

entries.englishMeaning: Build the Ark under Our protection and by Our revelation, and do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong; they will surely be drowned.
entries.editorialNote: Bi-a'yunina is rendered as protection and care.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording while denying eyes as bodily organs, parts or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Ayn and a'yun wording is read contextually as care, protection and oversight, without bodily implication.

entries.englishMeaning: Indeed, I have placed my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature except that He has complete control over it. Surely my Lord is upon a straight path of truth and justice.
entries.editorialNote: The baseline 'grasp it by the forelock' is rendered as complete control, avoiding any bodily grasp, hand or instrument.
entries.salafReading: Affirm Allah's complete control over creation while denying bodily grasping, limbs, instruments, contact or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: taking by the forelock signifies complete power, control and disposal over every creature, not a bodily grasp.

entries.englishMeaning: And to Thamud We sent their brother Salih. He said: O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He brought you forth from the earth and enabled you to settle it, so seek His forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. Indeed, my Lord is near by His knowledge and response, ever Responsive.
entries.editorialNote: Divine qurb is rendered non-spatially through knowledge and response, not distance, contact or location.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine nearness with a meaning befitting Allah while denying distance, physical proximity, contact, indwelling or location.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: Allah's nearness here is understood through His knowledge and response to those who call upon Him, not spatial distance.

entries.englishMeaning: He said: O my people, is my family more honoured by you than Allah, while you cast His command behind you in neglect? Surely my Lord's knowledge encompasses all that you do.
entries.editorialNote: Muhīt is rendered as encompassing knowledge rather than physical surrounding.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or any created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: Allah encompasses their deeds in knowledge, not by spatial enclosure.

entries.englishMeaning: Such is your Lord's punishment when He takes wrongdoing towns to account. His punishment is painful and severe.
entries.editorialNote: The repeated Pickthall 'grasp' wording is rendered as seizure in punishment and taking to account, not a bodily grasp.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed taking according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying bodily grasping, limbs, instruments, contact or movement.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: the divine taking is punishment and seizure of wrongdoers by power and decree, not physical grasping.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah is the One Who raised the heavens without visible pillars; then He exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne, without sitting, place, direction, movement, or bodily modality. He subjected the sun and moon, each running for an appointed term. He directs the affair and explains the signs so that you may be certain of meeting your Lord.
entries.editorialNote: This is one of the Qur'anic istiwa-over-the-Throne passages. Following the supplied guide's treatment of 20:5, the English uses the contextual ta'wil of absolute dominion/subjugation and explicitly rejects sitting, place, direction, movement and bodily modality.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form and every created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: istiwa over the Throne is rendered as Allah's absolute dominion and subjugation, never sitting, spatial establishment or movement. Allah's attribute of subjugation is not temporally originated.

entries.englishMeaning: They are those who remain steadfast, seeking their Lord's acceptance; establish prayer; spend secretly and openly from what We have provided them; and repel evil with good. Theirs is the good end of the Home.
entries.editorialNote: Wajh rabbihim is rendered as divine acceptance, not a bodily countenance.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: Those before them also plotted, but Allah has complete power to counter every plot. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom the final home will be.
entries.editorialNote: The phrase 'all plotting is Allah's' is rendered through Allah's power to counter and frustrate plots, not deceptive scheming.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying deception, deficiency, injustice or any created moral defect.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: every plot remains under Allah's power and judgment; He counters and frustrates wrongdoing without being described by human deception.

entries.englishMeaning: When I have fashioned him and placed within him a created spirit honored by Me, then fall down before him in prostration.
entries.editorialNote: My Spirit is treated as a created soul honored by attribution to Allah, not a part of Allah.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the possessive attribution while denying that Allah has a soul, spirit, part or anything separable from Him.
entries.khalafReading: Ruh attributed to Allah is a created spirit or angel honored by attribution to Him, not a part of Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: They fear their Lord's complete authority over them and do what they are commanded.
entries.editorialNote: Min fawqihim is rendered through supremacy and authority, not spatial direction.
entries.salafReading: Affirm Allah's supremacy while denying physical height, direction, location or spatial relation.
entries.khalafReading: Fawqiyyah is read as supremacy, authority and subjugation according to context, not spatial aboveness.

entries.englishMeaning: Indeed, Allah supports those who are mindful of Him and those who do good.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide explains Allah being 'with' the pious as support, not physical accompaniment, proximity or co-location.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a befitting meaning while denying physical accompaniment or location.
entries.khalafReading: The guide gives the specific meaning that Allah supports those who are pious.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Allah supports those who are pious.

entries.englishMeaning: And when We told you: surely your Lord's knowledge and power encompass mankind. We made the vision We showed you, and the accursed tree in the Qur'an, a test for people. We warn them, but it only increases them in great defiance.
entries.editorialNote: Divine encompassing is rendered through knowledge and power rather than spatial enclosure or bodily surrounding.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed encompassing with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical enclosure, spatial extension, contact or location.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: Allah encompasses mankind in knowledge and power, not by bodily or spatial surrounding.

entries.englishMeaning: Keep yourself patiently with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His acceptance. Do not let your eyes turn away from them, desiring the adornment of worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who follows his desire and whose affair is excessive.
entries.editorialNote: Wajhahu is rendered non-corporeally.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: She withdrew from them behind a veil, and We sent to her Our honored messenger-spirit, Gabriel, who appeared to her as a well-formed man.
entries.editorialNote: Our Spirit is rendered as the created angelic messenger Gabriel, not a part of Allah.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the possessive attribution while denying that Allah has a soul, spirit, part or anything separable from Him.
entries.khalafReading: Ruh attributed to Allah is a created spirit or angel honored by attribution to Him, not a part of Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them: worship Him and remain steadfast in His worship. Do you know anything similar to Him? There is none.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide uses this verse as a muhkam foundation negating any similarity to Allah.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Do you know of anything which is similar to Him? There is none.

entries.englishMeaning: The All-Merciful exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne with a subjugation without beginning; this does not mean sitting, place, direction, movement, or any bodily modality.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide identifies istiwa over the Throne as mutashabih, explicitly rejects sitting, resting, movement, place, direction, bodies and parts, and records Ibn Rajab al-Hanbali's explanation by al-istila (subjugation). The primary SalahOS English meaning therefore uses the guide's contextual ta'wil rather than leaving a bodily-sounding literal rendering.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form and every created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: istiwa over the Throne is rendered as Allah's absolute dominion and subjugation, never sitting, spatial establishment or movement. Allah's attribute of subjugation is not temporally originated.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Allah subjugated the Throne in al-azal with a subjugation which is without a beginning, like all of the attributes of Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: Saying: Place him in the chest, then cast it into the river, and the river will cast it onto the bank, where an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will take him. I bestowed love upon you from Me so that you would be brought up under My care.
entries.editorialNote: The project Ashari-Maturidi guide flags 20:39 as an 'ayn passage: a literal 'Eye' rendering is rejected, while care/watchful protection is acceptable. SalahOS therefore renders the expression as being brought up under Allah's care.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying an eye, organ, limb, body, direction, place, or created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: 'ala 'ayni is rendered as under My care and watchful protection, not as a bodily eye.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Under Allah's care and watchful protection.

entries.englishMeaning: He said: Do not fear. I am with you both by My knowledge and support; I hear and I see.
entries.editorialNote: The verse's ma'iyyah is explicitly non-spatial and tied to hearing, seeing and support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: He will say: Thus it is. Our signs came to you, but you neglected them; so today you are left to the consequence of that neglect.
entries.editorialNote: The passive 'you are forgotten' is rendered without attributing forgetfulness to Allah, which the supplied tanzih rule excludes as a deficiency.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording while categorically denying forgetfulness, ignorance, lapse, change or any deficiency in Allah.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: being 'forgotten' means being left without favour and abandoned to punishment as requital for neglecting Allah's signs.

entries.englishMeaning: And the woman who guarded her chastity: We caused an honored created spirit to be blown into her by Our command, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.
entries.editorialNote: Our Spirit is explicitly treated as created and honored, consistent with the supplied guide's treatment of 66:12.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the possessive attribution while denying that Allah has a soul, spirit, part or anything separable from Him.
entries.khalafReading: Ruh attributed to Allah is a created spirit or angel honored by attribution to Him, not a part of Allah.

entries.englishMeaning: Remember when We assigned to Ibrahim the site of the House: Do not associate anything with Me, and purify the House honored by Me for those who circle it, stand in worship, bow and prostrate.
entries.editorialNote: My House is rendered as a house honored by Allah, not Allah's residence.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the possessive attribution while denying residence, containment or a place for Allah.
entries.khalafReading: My House is an attribution of honor and consecration to Allah's worship, not Allah's dwelling.

entries.englishMeaning: We revealed to him: Build the Ark under Our protection and by Our revelation. When Our command comes and the oven gushes forth, take aboard a pair of every kind and your household except those against whom the decree has already passed. Do not plead with Me for the wrongdoers; they will surely be drowned.
entries.editorialNote: Bi-a'yunina is rendered as protection, not bodily eyes.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording while denying eyes as bodily organs, parts or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Ayn and a'yun wording is read contextually as care, protection and oversight, without bodily implication.

entries.englishMeaning: Say: Who has absolute dominion over all things, protecting while none can protect against Him, if you truly know?
entries.editorialNote: Bi-yadihi is rendered as absolute dominion and control.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed expression with a meaning befitting Allah while denying limbs, hands, parts, bodily form or created instruments.
entries.khalafReading: Yad and related expressions are read contextually as power, authority, generosity, care or disposal according to the verse, not as bodily hands.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah is the Creator of guidance for the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth. The example of His guidance is like a niche in which there is a lamp; the lamp is in glass, and the glass is as though it were a brilliant star, lit from a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even though no fire touched it: light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. Allah sets forth examples for people, and Allah knows all things.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide explicitly rejects understanding Allah as physical light. It gives the meaning that Allah is the Creator of guidance in the occupants of the heavens and the earth.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording without attributing created light, colour, luminosity or bodily properties to Allah.
entries.khalafReading: The guide gives the specific meaning that Allah is the Creator of guidance in the occupants of the heavens and the earth.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Allah is the Creator of guidance in the occupants of the skies and the occupants of the earth.

entries.englishMeaning: He created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six days; then He exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne, without sitting, place, direction, movement, or bodily modality. He is the All-Merciful; ask one well informed concerning Him.
entries.editorialNote: This is one of the Qur'anic istiwa-over-the-Throne passages. Following the supplied guide's treatment of 20:5, the English uses the contextual ta'wil of absolute dominion/subjugation and explicitly rejects sitting, place, direction, movement and bodily modality.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed istiwa according to a meaning befitting Allah while denying sitting, place, direction, movement, bodily form and every created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: istiwa over the Throne is rendered as Allah's absolute dominion and subjugation, never sitting, spatial establishment or movement. Allah's attribute of subjugation is not temporally originated.

entries.englishMeaning: He said: No. Go, both of you, with Our signs. We are with you by Our knowledge and support, hearing.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah is rendered as knowledge and support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: He said: No. My Lord supports me; He will guide me.
entries.editorialNote: The Arabic ma'iyyah here must not be read as physical co-location. In the immediate context of rescue and guidance, SalahOS renders it through Allah's support and guidance.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance, direction, or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta'wil: the ma'iyyah here is Allah's support, aid and guidance for Musa, not physical presence in a place.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: Allah supports and guides Musa.

entries.englishMeaning: They plotted a plot, and We countered their plot while they perceived not.
entries.editorialNote: The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording according to a meaning befitting Allah while maintaining tanzih: Allah does not resemble creation and is not described by body, limbs, composition, place, direction, movement, change, or a created modality.
entries.khalafReading: Contextual ta’wil: the divine action is a just requital, countermeasure or frustration of the wrongdoers’ act, not the created defect denoted when the same verb is used of people.

entries.englishMeaning: Do not invoke another god with Allah. There is no deity except Him. Everything will perish except His Dominion. Judgment belongs to Him, and to Him you will be returned.
entries.editorialNote: The supplied guide reports Imam al-Bukhari's explanation of 'illa wajhahu' as 'illa mulkahu': His Dominion. SalahOS therefore does not render wajh here as a bodily face.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wording with a meaning befitting Allah and deny a bodily face or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Imam al-Bukhari is cited in the supplied guide as explaining wajhahu here by mulkahu, His Dominion.
entries.guideSpecificMeaning: His Dominion.

entries.englishMeaning: Those who strive for Our sake, We will surely guide them to Our ways. Surely Allah supports the doers of good.
entries.editorialNote: Ma'iyyah is rendered as support.
entries.salafReading: Affirm divine ma'iyyah with a meaning befitting Allah while denying physical accompaniment, indwelling, proximity by distance or co-location.
entries.khalafReading: Ma'iyyah is read by context as knowledge, support, aid, protection or witness, never physical presence in a place.

entries.englishMeaning: Give the relative his due, and the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who seek Allah's acceptance, and they are the successful.
entries.editorialNote: Wajh Allah is rendered as seeking divine acceptance.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: Whatever you give as usury to increase through people's wealth brings no increase with Allah; but what you give in charity seeking Allah's acceptance—those are the ones whose reward is multiplied.
entries.editorialNote: Wajh Allah is rendered as divine acceptance rather than a face.
entries.salafReading: Affirm the revealed wajh wording with a meaning befitting Allah while denying a bodily face, countenance, direction or created form.
entries.khalafReading: Wajh is read contextually through meanings such as Allah Himself, His acceptance, His Dominion or the qiblah, as the supplied guide and verse context permit.

entries.englishMeaning: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six days; then He exercises absolute dominion over and subjugates the Throne, without sitting, place, direction, movement, or bodily modality. Besides Him you have no protecting ally or intercessor. Will you not remember?
entries.editorialNote: This is one of the Qur'anic istiwa-over-the-Throne passages. Following the supplied guide's treatment of 20:5, the English uses the contextual ta'wil of absolute dominion/subjugation and explicitly rejects sitting, place, direction, movement and bodily modality.
